# term/testdata

Expected outputs for the snapshot tests of the `term` package. All of them
are produced by codespan-reporting 0.13.1 (Rust); none is generated by the Go
code.

## snapshots/

The upstream `insta` snapshots in `codespan-reporting/tests/snapshots/`,
copied as-is from the 0.13.1 release. The inputs (sources and diagnostics) are
ported from `codespan-reporting/tests/term.rs` to `../snapshot_test.go` by
`scripts/gen.py`.

- Files are named `term__<case>__<test>.snap`.
- Do not edit them. To follow a new upstream release, copy them again with:

  ```sh
  scripts/sync-snapshots.sh <path to codespan-reporting>
  ```

## snapshots_extra/

Snapshots for cases that are not in upstream. The same inputs are written in
both `../snapshot_extra_test.go` and `rust/tests/extra.rs`, and the snapshots
are generated by running the Rust side with codespan-reporting 0.13.1:

```sh
cd term/testdata/snapshots_extra/rust
INSTA_UPDATE=always cargo test
```

- Files are named `extra__<case>__<test>.snap`.
- When adding a case, add it to both the Go test and `extra.rs`, then
  regenerate.
- `rust/tests/support/` holds the test helpers, based on upstream's
  `tests/support/`.
